defs.def: to no longer move; to make sb/sth no longer move （使）停止，停下

ex.s: “We’re not going to go cutting down any big old oaks,” and neither will the department completely stop planting new ones, said Auyeung.
ex.t: “我们不会去砍任何一棵高大的老橡树，”Auyeung说，管理局也不会完全停止种植新树。

ex.s: Most famously, a Canadian journalist who had moved her family to Manhattan in the early 1950s led a campaign to stop the destruction of her local park.
ex.t: 最著名的是，一位加拿大记者在1950年代初将她的家人迁至曼哈顿，他领导了一场停止她当地公园被毁的运动。

ex.s: I realized that if I didn’t stop, the entire lecture would be ruined.
ex.t: 我意识到如果我不停下来，整场讲座就会被毁掉。

ex.s: “Stop right there!
ex.t: “就在那儿停下！”

ex.s: So, should we stop traveling?
ex.t: 那么，我们应该停止旅行吗？

ex.s: Given the degree of doubt, Mr Stienwand suggests, “it would be wise to stop cloud seeding.” In practice, doubt has had the opposite effect.
ex.t: 鉴于怀疑的程度，斯坦万德先生建议：“停止人工降雨是明智的。”但在实践中，怀疑产生了相反的效果。

ex.s: C stop arguing whether the universe is a simulation
ex.t: C 停止争论宇宙是否是一个模拟。

ex.s: What should exchange students do if they choose to stop taking a course?
ex.t: 如果交换生选择停止修读一门课，他们该怎么做？

ex.s: Stop to have a rest now and then.
ex.t: 不时停下来休息一下。

ex.s: Stop comparing yourself with others.
ex.t: 停止拿自己和别人比较。

ex.s: We stop asking questions.
ex.t: 我们天生就有它们，只需要重新找回它们。

ex.s: We stop challenging custom.
ex.t: 我们不再挑战习俗。

ex.s: 46   Meanwhile, positive thinking can help to stop negative self-talks and start to form a positive view on an issue.
ex.t: 46   同时，积极思考能帮助停止消极的自我对话，并开始对事物形成积极的看法。

ex.s: It’s about two sisters-Eri，a model who either won’t or can’t stop sleeping，and Mari, a young student .
ex.t: 它讲的是两姐妹——要么不愿要么不能停止睡觉的模特艾里，和年轻学生玛丽。

ex.s: To figure out how much power these devices are using, Callie Babbitt and her colleagues at the Rochester Institute of Technology in New York tracked the environmental costs for each product throughout its life — from when its minerals are mined to when we stop using the device.
ex.t: 为了弄清楚这些设备用了多少电，纽约罗彻斯特理工学院的 Callie Babbitt 和她的同事们追踪了每种产品整个生命周期的环境成本——从矿物开采到我们停止使用该设备为止。

ex.s: Stop using them.
ex.t: 停止使用它们。

ex.s: 40     I find it hard to stop!
ex.t: 40 我发现很难停下来！

ex.s: "Oh， stop． There it is！"
ex.t: “哦，停。就在那里！”

ex.s: The first step in awakening senses is to stop predicting what we are going to see and feel before it occurs.
ex.t: 唤醒感官的第一步是在事情发生之前停止预测我们将要看到和感觉到什么。

ex.s: A few minutes late, the instructor asked me to stop the car.
ex.t: 几分钟后，教练让我把车停下来。

ex.s: The result is that people stop driving before they really need to.”
ex.t: 结果就是人们在真正需要停止驾驶之前就已经放弃了开车。"

ex.s: The teacher found I was struggling with note-taking and told me to stop and just listen.
ex.t: 老师发现我在记笔记方面有困难，就告诉我停下来只听讲。

ex.s: Father: (ignoring Grandfather' s words) Stop daydreaming!
ex.t: 父曰:(辱祖父之言)止日梦！

ex.s: Stop eating fast food and have breakfast every day.
ex.t: 停止吃快餐，每天要吃早餐。

ex.s: So, don’t stop speaking when you make a mistake unless it’s a truly serious one.
ex.t: 所以，除非犯了真正严重的错误，否则说错时不要停下来。

ex.s: The day was cold but clear: tourists and Londoners stopped to watch the skaters.
ex.t: 那天天气寒冷但晴朗：游客和伦敦人停下来观看滑板者。

ex.s: Poppy welcomed them home as usual but when she saw the box, she stopped.
ex.t: Poppy像往常一样欢迎他们回家，但当她看到盒子时，她停下来了。

ex.s: One of his friends had stopped to make a bicycle repair, but they had encouraged Mac to carry on, and they would catch up with him soon.
ex.t: 他的一个朋友停下来修自行车，但他们鼓励麦克继续前进，说很快就会赶上他。

ex.s: stop unwanted sound from affecting you
ex.t: 阻挡传入的声波

ex.s: It was a relief and I came to a suddenly stop just in the middle on the road.
ex.t: 这是一个解脱，我来到一个突然停止 就在中间的道路。

ex.s: After a short way, the farmer stopped and pointed at a weed which we missed.
ex.t: 走了一小段路后，农场主停下来，指着我们漏掉的一株杂草。

ex.s: Halfway through the poem, Miss Chevalier stopped me and asked if I knew what “impetuous” meant.
ex.t: 诗读到一半时，Chevalier小姐让我停下来，问我知道"impetuous"是什么意思吗。

ex.s: I stopped the ball and kicked it hardly back to the playground.
ex.t: 我停下球，用力把它踢回操场。

ex.s: The museum was free． We entered， excited． A group of people sitting in the hall stopped talking and stared at us．
ex.t: 博物馆免费。我们兴奋地走进去。大厅里坐着的一群人停下交谈，盯着我们看。

ex.s: There's a new frontier in 3D printing that's beginning to come into focus： food． Recent development has made possible machines that print， cook， and serve foods on a mass scale． And the industry isn't stopping there．
ex.t: 3D打印出现了一个新的前沿领域，正开始受到关注：食品。近期的发展使能够大规模打印、烹饪并供应食物的机器成为可能。而该行业并未止步于此。

ex.s: We've all known people who run out of steam before they reach life's halfway mark． I'm not talking about those who fail to get to the top． We can't all get there． I'm talking about people who have stopped learning on growing because they have adopted the fixed attitudes and opinions that all too often come with passing years．
ex.t: 我们都认识这样的人，他们在到达人生的中点之前就失去了动力。我说的不是那些没能登上顶峰的人。我们不可能都到达顶峰。我说的是那些停止学习和成长的人，因为他们接受了那些常常伴随岁月流逝而来的固定态度和观念。

ex.s: This delicious tour goes through the city on its way to Treasure Island where we will stop at the famous Winery SF.
ex.t: 这个美味的巡演在前往宝岛的途中穿过这座城市，在那里我们将停靠著名的Winery SF.

ex.s: It stops on the stone floor — and then turns, moving slowly towards a different corner of the cave, where the wind is calmer and the flies more plentiful.
ex.t: 它停在石地上——然后转身，缓缓爬向洞穴的另一个角落，那里风更平静，苍蝇也更多。

ex.s: That day I chose to stop hiding and embrace my shyness.
ex.t: 成功不仅仅在于谁能喊得最响亮。这个世界也需要安静的人。

defs.def: to no longer continue to do sth; to make sb/sth no longer do sth （使）中断，停止
to end or finish; to make sth end or finish （使）结束，终止
to prevent sb from doing sth; to prevent sth from happening 阻止；阻碍；阻拦；防止

ex.s: Breaking up firms like Google into five small ones would not stop remaking themselves: in time, one of them would become great again.
ex.t: 像谷歌这样的公司即使被拆分成五家小公司，也无法阻止它们重新崛起：迟早其中一家会再次壮大。

ex.s: The problem may be that, in our offices, we can't stop ourselves from getting drawn into others’ conversations while we’re trying to focus.
ex.t: 问题可能在于，在我们的办公室里，当我们试图专注时，我们无法阻止自己被卷入别人的对话。

ex.s: Stop things falling off trucks.
ex.t: 阻止东西从卡车上掉落。

ex.s: The global warming tread cannot be stopped.
ex.t: 全球变暖趋势无法阻止。

ex.s: I wasn't going to let a grade stop me from learning some of the best lessons of my life.
ex.t: 我不会让一个年级 阻止我学习一些 我生命中最好的教训。

ex.s: Studies have shown that it calculates the effort required for actions and tends to stop us from squandering vital resources on fruitless efforts, like walking over 30 km for a handful of berries.
ex.t: 研究表明，它会计算某项行动所需的努力，并倾向于阻止我们把宝贵的资源浪费在徒劳的努力上，比如走30多公里只为摘一把浆果。

ex.s: But that didn't stop China Daily from asking me last week to share a personal story for a video project about the integration of Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei province.
ex.t: 但这并没有阻止《中国日报》上周邀请我为一个关于京津冀一体化的视频项目分享个人故事。

ex.s: Then I put the tomatoes and the beaten eggs into pan together.  ＂Not that way，＂ my mom tried to stop us but failed.
ex.t: 然后我把西红柿和打好的鸡蛋一起放入锅中。"不是那样，"妈妈试图阻止我们但没成功。

ex.s: Now, lots of   7  (country)and regions are taking action to ban the sale of such bags to stop people using them.

ex.s: disability cannot stop a man's pursuit of success
ex.t: D. 残疾无法阻挡一个人对成功的追求。

ex.s: But that doesn't stop them having a friendly argument about which word is the “right” one!
ex.t: 但这并不妨碍他们就哪个词才是"正确的"进行一次友好的争论！

ex.s: In another letter, Father Christmas complained about how he could not stop his helpers playing games with the toys instead of wrappings them up.
ex.t: 在另一封信中，圣诞老人抱怨说，他无法阻止他的助手们玩玩具，而不是把玩具包起来。

ex.s: Matt Hunt said he was "very proud" of his son because “when the boy gets an idea, he keeps his head down and gets on with it, and he really does want to do some good and stop young kids from getting asthma."
ex.t: 马特·亨特说他为儿子感到“非常自豪”，因为“当男孩有了想法时，他会埋头苦干，坚持下去，而且他真的想做点好事，防止孩子们患上哮喘。”

ex.s: The processes take place to stop our brains becoming loaded with memories.
ex.t: 这些过程的目的是防止我们的大脑被记忆塞满。

ex.t: 我有一次其实想退掉这门课，但没退成，因为我不想让他因我的退缩而得逞。

ex.s: Would you BET on the future of this man？ He is 53 years old． Most of his adult life has been a losing struggle against debt and misfortune． A war injury has made his left hand stop functioning， and he has often been in prison． Driven by heaven﹣knows﹣what motives， he determines to write a book．
ex.t: 他已经53岁了，他的成年生活大多是债务和不幸的失败。战争的伤害使他的左手停止了运转，他经常在监狱里。由于天知道什么动机，他决定写一本书。

ex.s: He never stopped working, never retired.
ex.t: 他从不停下工作，从不退休。
